name: Thirty-two integers with many distinct 3-term progression differences
description: construct() -> exactly 32 distinct integers in 1..512. The score is the number of distinct d > 0 such that a, a + d, a + 2d all lie in the set for some a. Maximize. A 32-element set with many progression differences is a finite construction for this extremal function.

sources.locator: Marius Lemm, New counterexamples for sums-differences (2015). Crossref records inspected (Lemm 2015; Katz and Tao 1999). Erdős Problem #1097 page inspected: the question is equivalent to Bourgain's sums-differences problem; the optimal exponent lies in [1.77898..., 11/6] (Lemm, with a small improvement by AlphaEvolve; Katz and Tao), so the O(n^(3/2)) guess is false. No finite values are documented. A 32-element set with many progression differences is a finite construction for this extremal function.
Erdős Problem #1097 (open); statement, history and current bounds reviewed 2026-09-24.
